decisionTitle: Test the real mixed-page audit fault without weakening its oracle or changing clocks
decision: Keep the idle-start audit and every original verification guard. Age its private clock only, feed the real input-quiet scheduler, and reintroduce only the known retained-original metadata fault after a correct startup. Stream content-free mismatch/closure events before Worker termination and require exact unarmed cold writing. Test observations remain in isolated fixture builds; ordinary source and all prior tests are unchanged.
